title: serve the influencer list from /app and /v1
acceptance: GET /app/influencers and GET /v1/influencers return a paginated creator list with pagination meta carrying total
the query reads creator_profile_cache and profile through CTEs that each apply FINAL, and returns only rows with profile_type 'creator' and a null deleted_at
the list and count queries apply the same filters, so the total always describes the filtered set
categories, countries, genders, ageGroups and handle filters each narrow the result set, with categories matched against the JSON-encoded creator_tags column
excludeCategories, excludeCountries, excludeGenders and excludeAgeGroups each remove matching rows, mirroring the athletes and artists contracts
ageGroups and excludeAgeGroups accept only the six supported buckets and reject the overlapping data-quality values with a 400
the default sort is name ascending, and sortDirection is honoured
the mapper imports emptyToNull from lib/strings rather than redeclaring it, and parses creator_tags and creator_subtags into string arrays

the matrix — default, every filter in both include and exclude modes, both sort directions, and the count/list pair — is executed through the read-only ClickHouse MCP and its row counts recorded in the phase notes
the regenerated ClickHouse schema, OpenAPI document and API client are committed in this phase, so CI's check:generated finds no diff
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run influencers
notes: security_review is set because /v1 publishes inferred gender and age-group attributes for individual creator accounts to external API-key customers. creator_ethnicity exists in the source table and must not be exposed. Include/exclude filter pairs mirror artists and athletes so the shared @repo/ui/multi-select-filter control is usable unchanged. Matrix executed through the read-only ClickHouse MCP on 2026-08-11 (ClickHouse 26.2.1.558; creator_profile_cache 409,455 raw rows over 354,983 unique keys). Unfiltered total 155,785. categories=[Music] 59,381 and excludeCategories=[Music] 96,404 sum to the total, as do countries=[US] 56,832 and excludeCountries=[US] 98,953 — include and exclude are exact complements. genders=[female] + ageGroups=[25-34] + categories=[Music] 14,057. Handle search 'rollingstone' 1. ageGroups=[18-34] rejected with 400 by request validation. No smoke_cmd: the phase adds a route but the query verification belongs to the MCP, and the route itself is covered by routes.test.ts through the app.
